name: Oils, the long table
desc: A hall, a table, and the one cup nobody lifts.

shots.desc: a long timber banquet table down the centre of a stone hall, wooden benches on both sides, a wide stone fireplace burning at the far end, an iron chandelier of candles overhead, tapestries on the walls, vaulted timber roof beams, rushes on the floor, wide shot, no humans
figures seated along both sides of the long table, faces lit from the candles above and the fire behind, deep shadow in the roof beams, wide shot
one person at the head of the table mid-sentence, leaning forward into the candlelight, warm light on one side of the face, medium shot
a face far down the table receiving it, narrowed eyes, sidelong glance, pursed lips, arms crossed, leaning back out of the light, close-up
a full cup standing untouched on the timber, candle wax running down the iron of the chandelier above it, close-up, no humans

why: Oil painting wants a single warm source and large dark masses, and castle_great_hall supplies both as nouns rather than as adjectives: an iron chandelier with candles, a wide stone fireplace, tapestries, a vaulted timber roof. The style verdict is visible brush loading and warm impasto light, so the scene is lit by objects in the room instead of by a described mood. Dramatically this is the beat where a feast stops being a feast. Five shots: the room empty, the room full, one person talking, one person a long way down the table not answering, and then the cup. emotion:suspicion gives narrowed eyes, a sidelong glance and crossed arms, which is a posture the model can draw, unlike the abstraction the scene is actually about. Worth knowing before you use it: POST /api/compose reports that the firelight look contains location words - campfire, fire, dark background - and that they are stripped so the great hall survives while its colour and light are kept. That is the behaviour you want, and it explains where the campfire went. j_cut is set because speech leading picture is the natural grammar for a line landing on a listener.
note: Nothing rendered. The load-bearing risk is video and it is on the style card in plain terms: impasto is fine high-frequency surface texture, the working assumption on this box is that fine texture boils between LTX frames, and no oil-painted keyframe has ever been pushed through LTX-2.3 here. The card says render one clip before committing an act to it, and this template inherits that instruction. Stills are expected to be strong. Everything else is routine: transition:j_cut is advisory since short.py hard-cuts; lighting:candle and time:night are prompt words only with their numeric fields unwired; emotion:suspicion is status:partial upstream. One structural note - the speak template renders a mouth mid-sentence but there is no dialogue behind it, so the line is implied by the picture and by nothing else. And the master asks for several seated figures: templates cannot cast anybody, characters is not an accepted sets key, so the people will not be consistent from shot to shot.
